business_scope.primary_industry_name: Double-Shot PBT Plastic Injection of Novelty Keyboard Keycaps

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Unitary National Jurisdiction, no sub-state tax divergence)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic tradition; governed by the Código de Comercio, Ley 1258 de 2008 on the S.A.S., and Ley 1437 de 2011 on administrative procedure)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (investment chapter in force since May 15, 2012; no US-Colombia income tax treaty exists)
Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement and investment provisions (in force since August 15, 2011)
China-Colombia Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since July 6, 2012)
UK-Colombia Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 2014)
France-Colombia Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 2014)
Spain-Colombia Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 2007)
Andean Community Decision 578 (double taxation and investment facilitation regime among Colombia, Peru, Ecuador and Bolivia)
Colombia-OECD instruments (OECD accession effective April 28, 2020, reinforcing MFN and responsible-business-conduct disciplines)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime, non-resident shareholder authorization); Ley 526 de 1999 as amended by Ley 1121 de 2006 and Ley 1621 de 2013 (UIAF and AML/CFT system); Ley 1762 de 2015 (money laundering and assets forfeiture); Ley 2010 de 2019, Estatuto Tributario Article 631-1 (definition of final beneficial owner); DIAN Resolución 000098 de 2022 (Registro de Beneficiario Final); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Básica Jurídica 100-000015 de 2023 (SARLAFT obligations for supervised real-sector entities); Decreto 1463 de 2016 (implementation of UN asset-freeze lists); Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, Articles 68-113 and 354-359 (shareholder registration and inspection rights).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (the S.A.S. shareholder ledger is a private internal record; natural-person beneficial-owner particulars are filed with the DIAN final-beneficiary registry and UIAF supervisory channels, and are not disclosed on the public Chamber of Commerce existence certificate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport or national identity document of each natural-person UBO and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public and passport authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization via a Colombian embassy if the country of origin is not party to the 1961 Hague Convention), followed by Spanish sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney from each non-resident UBO/shareholder appointing the local incorporator and registered commercial agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions), followed by Spanish sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, commercial registration extract and certificate of good standing of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official companies registry of the corporate shareholder's country of origin (e.g., UK Companies House, Delaware Division of Corporations)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and Spanish sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank or professional reference letter verifying the source of funds of each UBO holding 5% or more of the entity (required for DIAN final-beneficiary record and AML file)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or audited professional accountant in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; the letter must be dated within 90 days of the incorporation filing

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Colombian S.A.S. Statute), Articles 1-6, 22 and 24; supplementary application of the Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 19, 98, 110-115; Decree 1074 of 2015 (mercantile registry rules); Ley 1429 de 2010 (business formalization incentives).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil — Cámara de Comercio de [Bogotá D.C. / selected city], integrated into the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) under the administrative supervision of the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) with authenticated signatures or a valid electronic signature, inscribed in the Registro Mercantil; if real property is contributed, a public deed (Escritura Pública) before a Notary is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital for an S.A.S. under Law 1258/2008, Article 5; shareholders freely determine authorized, subscribed and paid-in capital. Any unpaid instalments must be contributed within 24 months of incorporation. Cash contributions require no escrow account under Colombian law; in-kind contributions must be specifically identified and formally transferred in the incorporation instrument. The departmental registration tax (0.5%-0.7% of subscribed capital) applies at inscription.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] SAS. At the initial shareholders' meeting held on [date], the subscribing shareholders hereby resolve: 1. The subscribed shares of the corporate capital are accepted as per the articles of incorporation, payable within twenty-four months. 2. The registered office is fixed at [registered address], [city], Colombia; the Legal Representative is empowered to complete the registry formalities at the Chamber of Commerce. 3. [Name] is appointed Legal Representative and [Name] Deputy Representative, jointly empowered to open bank accounts, obtain the NIT/RUT, and execute corporate obligations. 4. The officers are authorized to enrol the company with DIAN, the municipal register, and the social security system, and to onboard the Stripe and Shopify payment rails. Unanimously approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Homonym Search (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de [Bogotá D.C. / selected city] — online portal via RUES (www.rues.org.co) or in-person window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names through the RUES portal, ending the preferred name with 'S.A.S.' Pay the search fee and obtain the Homonym Certificate confirming that no identical or confusingly similar trade name is registered; the certificate is valid for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: RUES name-reservation application form
Identification document (cédula or passport) of the applicant/shareholder
Valid e-mail address and contact telephone number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the first-choice name is confronted by homonymy, select an alternative name from the submitted list or add a distinguishing element; re-file immediately within the 30-day validity window at no additional search fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Authentication of the Incorporation Instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública [number] in the registry city for signature authentication, or the Cámara de Comercio online SAS formation service using a certified electronic signature
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bylaws (estatutos) containing all mandatory clauses: corporate name ending in S.A.S., registered office, corporate purpose (ISIC 3240 / CIIU keyboard keycap manufacture), share classes and series, subscribed and paid-in capital, administration structure, term and fiscal year. Each shareholder signs the document; signatures are authenticated before the notary or executed electronically. If real estate is contributed, convert the instrument into a public deed.
required_dossiers: Valid Homonym Certificate
Copy of each shareholder's identification document
Draft estatutos with capital allocation and officer appointments
Notarial fee payment proof or electronic signature credentials
Optional: documented valuation report for in-kind contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or the Chamber issues observations on missing mandatory clauses, correct the statute text and re-authenticate; monitor the 30-day homonym validity and refile promptly to avoid re-running the name search.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil) before the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil — Cámara de Comercio de [Bogotá D.C. / selected city], in-person or electronic submission via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed and authenticated incorporation instrument together with the provisional pre-RUT generated from DIAN and the registered-office address details. Pay the registration rights (derechos de inscripción) and the departmental registration tax (impuesto de registro, 0.5%-0.7% of subscribed capital). Upon approval, the Chamber records the company, assigns the definitive NIT through DIAN's electronic integration, and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, which perfects the legal personality.
required_dossiers: Signed and authenticated Documento Privado de Constitución
Valid Homonym Certificate
Pre-RUT form (registered address and activities)
Identification of the appointed Legal Representative
Proof of payment of registration rights and impuesto de registro
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry officer raises observations, the Legal Representative must correct the document within 5 business days and re-present it; the original filing date is preserved for continuity of the legal personality, and the registration fee is not re-charged for the corrected version.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Enrollment — NIT/RUT with DIAN and E-Invoicing Authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) — MUISCA online portal (muisca.dian.gov.co) or authorized DIAN service office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the provisional NIT assigned during registration and complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) via MUISCA, declaring applicable obligations: corporate income tax, VAT (IVA), national consumption tax (where applicable), and withholding agent duties. Request the electronic invoicing certificate (firma electrónica) and obtain the authorization for facturación electrónica; register the relevant CIIU codes for the manufacturing and commercial sale of custom keyboard keycaps.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Identification document of the Legal Representative
Incorporation instrument and bylaws
Corporate e-mail address and RUT update form
Proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or corrects the RUT data, file an 'actualización RUT' correction through MUISCA with the precise responsible-obligation codes; if the Legal Representative is a non-resident, appoint a local agent (apoderado) with Colombian tax ID and a notarized power of attorney to complete registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Payment Rails Onboarding (Stripe and Shopify)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA Colombia) plus Stripe and Shopify Payments platform onboarding; Superintendencia Financiera rules apply to the bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate current account presenting the certified incorporation documents and the RUT; the First Board Resolution designates the signatories. After the account is active, complete Stripe's know-your-business (KYB) onboarding using the Colombian NIT, bank verification deposits, and the corporate certificate; connect Shopify Payments to the same Stripe account. This enables local COP settlement and global card payment capture for the e-commerce storefront.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT and NIT certificate
Identification of the Legal Representative and authorized signatories
First Board Resolution with signature authority
Utility bill or lease of the registered office
Bank KYC form and beneficial-ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank's OFAC/KYC compliance blocks the account, submit refreshed UBO declarations and notarized source-of-funds documentation; if Stripe KYB is rejected, provide the Spanish-language NIT certificate with an official translation and re-submit the onboarding application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Alcaldía Municipal / Secretaría de Planeación (Curaduría Urbana) for land-use certification; Secretaría de Hacienda for the Matrícula de Industria y Comercio; Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for environmental permits; Cuerpo de Bomberos for fire safety
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Certificate of Land Use (Certificado de Uso del Suelo), Matrícula de Industria y Comercio, and Certificado de Seguridad Humana y Contra Incendios for the plastic injection production facility

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) / Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) under the Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category — Environmental Registration without a full EIA: small-scale plastic injection plants below Decree 1076/2015 Annex II licensing thresholds are not subject to a full environmental impact assessment; they must obtain the CAR environmental registration, a Wastewater Discharge Permit (Permiso de Vertimientos) if discharging, and a Hazardous Waste Generator Registration (Registro de Generador de Residuos Peligrosos).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater to municipal sewer: pH 6.0-9.0, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, COD ≤ 200 mg/L, total petroleum hydrocarbons ≤ 10 mg/L (Resolución 0631/2015); air emissions: VOC ≤ 60 mg/m³, particulate matter ≤ 10 mg/m³ (Resolución 909/2008 and Resolución 2254/2017); noise: ≤ 65 dB(A) daytime and ≤ 55 dB(A) nighttime at the industrial-zone perimeter (Resolución 627/2006); solid plastic waste must be transferred to a licensed valoriser and hazardous waste disposed through a CAR-authorised transporter.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (Certificado de Seguridad Humana y Contra Incendios) issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos under Ley 1575/2012 and Resolución 0661/2014; structural load inspection certificate for the injection-moulding floor issued by the Curaduría Urbana; mandatory SG-SST occupational health registration (Decreto 1072/2015) with the ARL covering noise, heat, and ergonomic risks; RETIE electrical installation safety certificate for the industrial machinery; and municipal inspection, surveillance and control (IVC) authorization for the physical production site.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – official portal www.dian.gov.co; electronic services via DIAN 'Muisca' portal
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian S.A.S., the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) is assigned by DIAN upon incorporation and registration with the Cámara de Comercio. The company must then file the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) within 30 days, select its tax classifications (IVA responsible, source-withholding agent, exporter status), obtain an electronic signature certificate, and activate the DIAN electronic invoicing software. A non-resident parent entity earning Colombian-source income must appoint a local legal representative and separately obtain its own NIT through the RUT procedure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Colombia. A qualifying S.A.S. may elect the optional 'Régimen SIMPLE' for small taxpayers where annual gross income does not exceed 100,000 UVT, which replaces ordinary income tax and IVA. Industrial exporters may also elect to operate under Zona Franca benefits, receiving a reduced 20% corporate income tax rate. Hybrid mismatch and anti-abuse rules apply under Law 1943 of 2018 and BEPS-aligned regulations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) – Value Added Tax / GST administered by DIAN
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Registration is mandatory for all legal entities engaged in sales of taxable goods or services, irrespective of turnover. Natural persons may obtain 'no responsable' status if previous-year gross income is below approximately 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 154,000,000 for 2025) and they are not importers or exporters. For the optional SIMPLE regime, annual gross income must not exceed 100,000 UVT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia mandates real-time electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta) through DIAN. Invoices must be generated by DIAN-authorised software, transmitted to DIAN via secure HTTPS/XML APIs, validated in real time, and returned with a valid CUDE and QR code before being legally effective. Export invoices follow the same framework, and customs clearance requires electronic submission of the Export Declaration (DEX) via the VUCE single window.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods manufactured in Colombia, such as custom mechanical keyboard caps, qualify for IVA at 0% when sold to a foreign buyer and definitively exported outside Colombian customs territory. The seller must be registered with DIAN as an IVA-responsible exporter, hold valid export customs documentation, and prove the goods departed Colombia. Services directly related to the exported goods may also qualify under statutory conditions.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX) – definitive electronic export customs declaration accepted by DIAN/VUCE
Bill of Lading (BL) or air waybill / manifiesto de carga
Commercial invoice (factura comercial) describing the goods and transaction
Certificate of origin or certificate of preferential origin (if applicable)
Declaración de Cambio (Form 1) and bank certificate of forex settlement evidencing repatriation of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN rigorously audits export zero-rating claims. Undocumented exports, false declarations, or unrepatriated proceeds trigger the inexactness penalty (sanción por inexactitud) of 100% to 200% of the omitted IVA, plus default interest and full retrospective clawback of any VAT refunds. Criminal tax evasion, including fraudulent zero-rating schemes, can result in imprisonment, disqualification from export incentives, and cancellation of the exporter registration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Bank of the Republic), acting as the central bank and primary foreign-exchange authority, with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia as the supervisor of authorized exchange intermediaries, and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) exercising linked customs and exchange-control enforcement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed floating peso with full convertibility on the current account for trade-related payments, service payments, interest, and dividend repatriation, provided all flows are channelled through the Mercado Cambiario and evidenced by a Declaración de Cambio (DCIN). Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment, external loans, portfolio investment, and derivative operations, are subject to registration with the Banco de la República and must be executed through an authorized intermediary. Dividend and profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are legally permitted after verification of registered net earnings and after satisfying the applicable corporate income tax and non-resident dividend withholding tax obligations; no discretionary foreign-exchange license is required, but proper exchange-form filing is mandatory.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters of goods, including custom keyboard keycaps manufactured under ISIC 3240, must invoice and collect export proceeds through the Colombian exchange market. The statutory collection term runs from the date of shipment, generally requiring receipt within six months, unless extended under Banco de la República rules for specific goods or financing terms. One hundred percent of the export value in foreign currency must be sold or otherwise surrendered through an authorized exchange intermediary, and the corresponding Declaración de Cambio must be submitted via that intermediary. The proceeds are converted to Colombian pesos at the prevailing market rate, and the transaction is recorded under the exporter's foreign-exchange registration profile.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account (COP and foreign currency)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account (COP and foreign currency)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account (COP and foreign currency)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account (COP and foreign currency)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account (COP and foreign currency)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. A foreign digital EMI or electronic-money institution is not authorized by the Colombian legal framework to maintain local demand deposits or provide local account numbers in Colombia. Such platforms may be used only as payment collection gateways and are not a substitute for the regulated clearing bank rail. The treasury structure must therefore use a Colombian commercial bank as principal account and FX intermediary, with foreign EMIs limited to ancillary card-acquiring or payout services.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Completely remote account opening is possible under Colombian digital-knowledge rules, but in practice Tier-1 banks often require at least one legal representative holding Colombian presence, or a notarized and apostilled power of attorney from non-resident directors, plus a sworn statement of ultimate beneficial owners. A physical or virtual KYC interview with the compliance officer is standard for a foreign-owned S.A.S.; the company must present the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation from the Chamber of Commerce, the NIT (tax ID), corporate bylaws, board or shareholder resolutions, passport copies, and valid proof of address.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership appears indirect, layered, or lacking a clear economic nexus to the Colombian entity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO declaration with a chain of ownership for each natural person above 5% direct or indirect participation; registration of beneficial owners in the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB); latest Certificado de Cámara de Comercio and Existence and Legal Representation certificate; corporate chart with full personal identification; passport copies and residency proof for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital contribution or projected transaction volume is inconsistent with the low-risk profile of a custom keyboard keycap manufacturer
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Structured business plan and 12-month cash-flow forecast; supplier agreements for PBT resin and injection tooling; purchase orders or letters of intent from e-commerce distributors; bank statements of the funding investor; valuation certificate if any capital contribution is made in-kind; affidavit of source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound funds originate in jurisdictions that raise enhanced due diligence concerns or are not clearly linked to the shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth and source-of-funds letter; three months of original bank statements from the remitting account; certified copy of the shareholder registry and corporate resolution approving the capital contribution; evidence of economic activity supporting the cash surplus; tax identification and registry documents of the investing entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Online sales through Shopify or Stripe show recurring cross-border payments without physical invoices or transport documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform settlement reports and transaction ledgers; order and refund history; commercial invoices issued to customers; customs and logistics documents, including freight bills and courier manifests; trademark or IP evidence if relevant; agreed merchant-of-record arrangement with Shopify Payments or Stripe if the latter is the invoicing seller.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound foreign direct investment must be routed through an authorized Colombian bank. The contribution should be remitted by SWIFT MT103 identifying the foreign investor, the Colombian company's NIT, and the purpose as 'capital contribution / foreign direct investment'. Prior to or upon receipt, the company must complete the foreign investment registration with the Banco de la República through the intermediary bank, using the standardized Declaración de Inversión Internacional and the applicable exchange concept code for formation or increase of capital. The incoming USD or EUR is converted to COP through the authorized intermediary at the market rate and credited to the company's COP operating account. The underlying wire should include the foreign investment registration code where available and must be supported by a board resolution, share issuance documentation, and proof of funding.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments to overseas suppliers of PBT resin, pigments, tooling, packaging, and logistics services are made through SWIFT MT103 over the company's Colombian bank. For larger or recurring purchase obligations, the company may use a commercial documentary letter of credit issued by its Colombian bank (SWIFT MT700/MT707) with presentation of commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, and any required compliance certificates. All foreign-sourced imports are reported in the exchange declaration filed by the intermediary at the time of payment or collection, ensuring the disbursement has a genuine underlying trade and is not construed as a capital flight transaction. Shopify and Stripe balances generated from export sales should be settled periodically into the Colombian clearing bank account and converted to COP in compliance with export-proceeds surrender rules.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable COP/USD forward contracts with a Colombian authorized intermediary, supported by real trade or cash-flow exposure
Non-deliverable forward contracts (NDFs) on Colombian pesos, executed only through locally authorized institutions and with documented underlying exposure
Cross-currency swaps between COP and USD for long-term commercial or financing exposure, subject to Banco de la República registration rules
FX swaps used for short-term management of peso-dollar liquidity within the permitted exchange-market categories
Foreign-exchange options bought through a locally regulated intermediary, where options are backed by a verifiable commercial or balance-sheet exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación anual de la matrícula mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio / RUES – Registro Único Empresarial y Social
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A statutory surcharge of 10% of the renewal fee accrues for each month or fraction of a month of delay; persistent non-renewal can lead to administrative cancellation of the commercial registration and loss of legal standing before the Chamber of Commerce.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de estados financieros (Deposit of Audited or Certified Financial Statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 working days after approval by the annual shareholders' meeting; the meeting must be held by March 31 for calendar-year entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit the financial statements may subject the company to enforcement action by the Superintendencia de Sociedades, fines under the Commercial Code, and diminished evidentiary standing of the accounts in corporate disputes.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Informe Anual de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before October 31 for the corresponding taxable period, pursuant to DIAN Resolution 164/2021
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate filing may result in fines of up to 100 UVT (approximately USD 1,300), and the UBO information gap may suspend or block other pending DIAN tax procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between April 20 and May 10 of the following tax year, determined by the last two digits of the company's NIT (standard calendar-year filer)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a penalty equal to 5% of the tax payable, with a minimum of 10 UVT, plus monthly default interest at the applicable DIAN rate; repeat offenses can raise penalty amounts and trigger criminal exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Acta de Asamblea General Ordinaria (Annual Ordinary Shareholders' Meeting Minutes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio / RUES (registration of minutes in the statutory books)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Meeting must be convened and held within three months after the fiscal year-end, i.e., by March 31 for a calendar-year SAS; minutes should be recorded in the shareholders' minute book immediately thereafter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the annual meeting within the statutory period makes the financial statements not legally approved, invalidates the year-end corporate filings, and may expose directors and controlling shareholders to fiduciary liability claims.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (SAS) is required to appoint a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) if, during the immediately preceding fiscal year, gross assets exceed 30,000 SMMLV or gross revenues exceed 30,000 SMMLV; mandatory audit is also triggered where the bylaws or the shareholders' meeting so resolve, or where applicable tax law requires audited statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian financial reporting follows the NIIF/IFRS regime as adopted by Law 1314 of 2009 and DIAN regulations: Grupo 1 applies full IFRS; Grupo 2 applies IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para las PYMES); Grupo 3 applies the simplified microenterprise accounting framework. A custom-mechanical-keycap manufacturing SAS operating online with standard revenue levels normally falls within Grupo 2.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Colombian SAS must identify, record, and annually report all ultimate beneficial owners to DIAN through the mandatory Beneficiario Final reporting framework. The report must reflect any shareholding transfers during the year, and the internal share register must be updated before the annual confirmation is filed. Annual re-confirmation is due by October 31 of each year. Failure to update the UBO registry after each share transfer before the annual filing constitutes a reportable compliance defect and exposes the company to fines.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors / Board Meeting Minutes (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva, where applicable)
Shareholders' Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Colombian S.A.S. entities are subject to general income tax at 35% with no unconditional tax-holiday regime. Deductions available for wages, raw materials, depreciation, and productivity investments. A qualified investment in science, technology, and innovation may be eligible for enhanced deductions under DIAN rules. From tax year 2023, net operating losses may offset no more than 25% of the liquid taxable income in any subsequent year and cannot be carried beyond five years. No pass-through treatment is available for an S.A.S.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 - Declaración de Renta y Complementarios, filed electronically through the DIAN MUISCA web portal using an authorized electronic signature.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; interim income tax prepayments and monthly withholding tax returns are separate electronic filings.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For calendar-year taxpayers, the annual Form 210 is due in the calendar year following the fiscal year-end according to the last digit of the NIT, generally between August and late September. The exact DIAN schedule is published annually before the filing season; no blanket extension exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number of the Colombian S.A.S., including the verification digit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not file Form 210 in their own name. A foreign-owned S.A.S. files under its locally issued NIT as a Colombian resident entity. A foreign company operating through a Colombian permanent establishment files under the branch's own NIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Primary economic activity code; for custom mechanical keyboard keycaps manufactured by injection molding, use ISIC/CIIU 3240 and align the DIAN registration with the actual commercial activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Colombian entity must report income from manufacturing and e-commerce sales under this code. A non-resident principal may not attribute marketplace sales to the S.A.S. unless the S.A.S. genuinely operates a dependent agency or fixed place of business in Colombia.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, S.A.S. registration data, fiscal year, and domicile. Ensure Chamber of Commerce certificate, DIAN registration, and factual place of administration are consistent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the sole shareholder is abroad, the S.A.S. remains resident and must file. The foreign shareholder does not file Form 210 solely by reason of ownership but must appoint a local representative for tax notifications if required by DIAN.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report gross revenue before deductions, including sales through Shopify, Stripe, marketplaces, export sales, and any ancillary income. Payment-card processing fees are expenses, not reductions of gross income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A contract-manufacturing S.A.S. should include only its manufacturing margin and contractual consideration in gross income; pass-through flows of the foreign principal require documented transfer-pricing analysis and must not be booked as revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Boxes 36-38 - Returns, rebates, discounts, and non-taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct sales returns and promotional discounts supported by credit memos; include only statutory exemptions as non-taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capital contributions from the non-resident parent are not taxable income. Distributions or refunds must be allocated to the legal entity that performed the underlying transaction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Record raw materials, injection molding costs, labor, logistics, software, licenses, and administrative overhead. Every deduction must be supported by an electronic invoice, bank evidence, and business purpose.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party services, royalties, and management fees from a foreign parent are deductible only if the recipient has substantive functions, risks, and assets; otherwise DIAN may disallow the deduction and apply transfer-pricing adjustments. Withholding at statutory or treaty rate must be evidenced.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Boxes 62, 72, 75 - Taxable income and income tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Determine liquid taxable income after applying NOL carryforwards within the five-year cap and the 25% annual offset limit, then apply the 35% corporate rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No tax consolidation is allowed with a foreign parent. NOLs generated by the Colombian S.A.S. cannot be transferred to or from non-resident affiliates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Boxes 77-86 - Tax payable, credits, and balance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply advance payments, withholding tax credits, and tax credits; report the final balance payable or refundable. Payment of the balance is made through DIAN-authorized banking channels using the NIT reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholding tax on dividends or remittances to foreign shareholders is declared separately by the Colombian S.A.S. as withholding agent and cannot be credited against the corporate income tax payable by the nonresident shareholder.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form 210 triggers the late-return sanction under the Tax Code: 5% of the tax assessment for each month or fraction of delay, capped at 100%. If no tax is payable, the sanction is 0.5% of gross income per month, subject to a minimum of one UVT. Default interest applies from the original due date. Inaccurate returns may be penalized up to 100% of the understated tax difference, and criminal prosecution is possible for fraudulent omission.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced dividend withholding rate under a Colombia tax treaty, the foreign shareholder must certify and evidence beneficial ownership, hold the investment through the relevant period, and obtain an official tax residency certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign competent authority. The TRC and a beneficial-ownership declaration must be delivered to the Colombian payer or withholding agent before the dividend is paid. If the reduced treaty rate is not applied at source, the non-resident shareholder must file a refund claim with DIAN and provide the complete supporting documentation together with the amended withholding declaration.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statute imposes 15% withholding tax on cross-border royalties and 15% on interest paid to non-residents. Treaty relief may reduce these rates; under the Colombia-United States DTA, for example, interest and royalties generally qualify for a 10% source-country rate, and other DTAs vary between 0% and 15%. Beneficial ownership and TRC documentation remain conditions for treaty relief.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: For tax year 2024, the mandatory Transfer Pricing Documentation, Informative Transfer Pricing Return, and Local File/Master File obligations are triggered if gross income or gross assets equal or exceed 100,000 UVT (approximately COP 4,706,500,000 using a UVT of COP 47,065), or if related-party transactions equal or exceed 10,000 UVT (approximately COP 470,650,000). Even below these thresholds, any cross-border related-party transaction must be reported in the informative return and priced at arm's length.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not operate a UAE-style formal Economic Substance Regulations regime, but it applies a robust economic-substance doctrine through the general anti-abuse rule and transfer-pricing principles. A foreign-owned S.A.S. manufacturing custom keyboard keycaps must demonstrate real employees, premises, raw-material purchase functions, inventory risk, production machinery, and independent decision-making. A S.A.S. that merely channels royalties, commissions, or marketplace sales without substantive operational activity may be recharacterized as a shell by DIAN, with all intercompany deductions disallowed and unilateral transfer-pricing adjustments imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly omitting Shopify or Stripe sales, issuing false electronic invoices, understating gross receipts, fabricating raw-material purchases, or using altered cost invoices to reduce the taxable base. The threshold for criminal tax evasion is the equivalent of 500 SMMLV in understated tax impact.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax evasion under the Colombian Penal Code as amended by Law 1819 of 2016 carries imprisonment of 36 to 72 months. Administratively, DIAN imposes an inexactness penalty up to 100% of the tax difference plus default interest and may suspend the NIT for invoicing violations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, legal representatives, and sole shareholders who sign fraudulent returns or order the omission are jointly and severally liable for the tax debt. Courts may impose travel bans, asset embargos, and imprisonment; the corporate veil is pierced under S.A.S. Law 1258 of 2008 when the company is used for fraud.
